batchId: Claude manual-research batch dc-01 (4 DC identities from the Needs manual research list)
method: Web search snippets from the cited pages; claims the snippet did not support were left out or listed under unknowns. No numeric tiers or win probabilities. All records stay provisional until a different contributor checks the cited support.
baselineContinuity: Mainline DC Comics unless a record says otherwise.

characters.continuity: Mainline DC Comics (Superman: The Man of Steel #17-18, 1992 through subsequent comic appearances and story arcs including The Death of Superman, Hunter/Prey, Doomsday Wars, and Reign of Doomsday). Excludes standalone live-action and animated media outside the primary comic continuity.
characters.summary: Doomsday is a genetically engineered prehistoric Kryptonian monster driven by an instinctive hatred of all life. He fights as an overwhelming, relentlessly advancing brute who relies on unmatched physical strength, near-total invulnerability, and an evolutionary adaptation factor that resurrects him immune to any previous cause of death.

techniques: copies powers of nearby super-beings (absorption cells, as described by one secondary source)

mechanisms: rapid cellular regeneration and healing factor
reactive physiological evolution that makes him immune to whatever harmed him previously

weaknesses: utter lack of intelligence or tactical restraint, relying entirely on forward momentum and destruction
extreme measures such as the End of Time or total molecular dispersal can temporarily contain him
No sourced weakness in the cited pages; reviewer should add one from specific issues
Described as feral and mindless in the early Superman stories, which limits planning

mobility: super speed and superhuman agility (publisher power list)
limitations: mindless rage makes him predictable to tactical opponents
requires time to reconstitute after total destruction

characters.continuity: DC Comics (Mainline DC continuity from Green Lantern vol. 2 #87, 1971 onward, including Justice League comics, Green Lantern Corps, and subsequent comic series)
characters.summary: John Stewart is a Marine veteran, former architect, and veteran Green Lantern who wields a Power Ring to manifest precise, durable, and structurally sound hard-light constructs. He relies on tactical discipline, architectural precision, and sheer willpower rather than brute force.
weaknesses: Ring charge depletion requiring periodic re-energization
Psychological trauma from past structural failures
Classic ring weakness to yellow (one source says his ring still has it)
Powers come from the ring, not from John himself

limitations: Ring requires recharging via Power Battery

sources.supports: Basic biography, Marine veteran, architect background, and Green Lantern ring capabilities.

characters.continuity: DC Comics (Mainline DC continuity from Aquaman vol. 1 #11, 1963 onward, including New Earth and Prime Earth storylines)
characters.summary: Mera is the Queen of Atlantis and a powerful hydrokinetic warrior from Xebel. She can manipulate water into dense, hard-light-like solid constructs, tidal waves, and localized water spheres to trap opponents, backed by Atlantean superhuman physical attributes.

techniques: hard water objects such as water missiles

weaknesses: Vulnerability to extreme dehydration or heavy lead poisoning in certain storylines
Deprivation of water sources limits hydrokinetic output
Exposure to lead removes her hard-water powers
Power depends on water being available

depictions.title: Mainline DC Comics Mera of Xebel and Dimension Aqua, Aquaman's wife (New Earth and Prime Earth). Excludes Flashpoint, Justice, Smallville and film versions.

mobility: Can travel between Dimension Aqua and Earth
Can propel herself through the air with enough nearby water (Looper)
limitations: Hydrokinesis effectiveness decreases significantly in arid environments without moisture

sources.supports: Mera's history, hydrokinetic powers, origin in Xebel, and role as Queen of Atlantis.

Can extract water from other sources and propel herself through the air if enough water is nearby
